title: Advanced Topics in Civil Engineering; Pavement Engineering: Design, Materials, and Emerging Technologies with AI/ML Applications
description: This course introduces the principles and practices of pavement engineering, with a special emphasis on integrating artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) into pavement evaluation, design, and management. Students will gain a strong foundation in pavement materials, structural design, and mechanistic-empirical methods, while exploring advanced computational tools for predictive modeling, image-based condition assessment, and intelligent pavement management.
